subject: a single violet artichoke cut to reveal its pale heart
art_direction: 一颗紫色洋蓟剖面露出奶白中心，层层苞片像有节奏的植物雕塑。
visible_description: 一颗紫色洋蓟剖面露出奶白中心，层层苞片像有节奏的植物雕塑。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a single violet artichoke cut to reveal its pale heart. Arrange the thick overlapping bracts around a clearly visible ivory heart. The cut edge faces the viewer, while one loose bract curls outward. Render subtle veins and matte waxy surfaces without filling every area with detail. Use a deep muted sage background that separates the violet outer silhouette from the pale center. Use detailed botanical painting. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
